title: Alert Curator Workbench — Handoff Playbook & SLO-aware Suggestions
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Design and prototype a consolidated 'Alert Curator Workbench' in the Redwood Console that guides engineers and on-call owners through building reliable, cost-aware alerts and generating a one-click handoff playbook for incidents and postmortems. The workbench surfaces SLO-aware thresholds, cost routing hints, and embeds postmortem links and runbook snippets for quick responder context.
acceptance_criteria: A visually consistent workbench panel exists in the Alerts creation flow with primary/secondary panes
SLO-aware threshold suggestions are displayed with rationale and delta-to-current-SLO
One-click export generates a handoff playbook (Markdown) containing alert rationale, suggested runbook snippets, and links to relevant dashboards and postmortem template
Cost routing hint shows expected cost delta when selecting retention/batching choices and suggests fallback models/regions
Prototype tested in 3 design reviews with engineering and at least one on-call rotation included in feedback loop

usability_notes: Prefer progressive disclosure: keep primary alert rule fields in focus and collapse SLO/cost helpers behind a single 'Explain' affordance
Handoff export should default to minimal context (title, symptoms, runbook snippet, dashboard links) with an optional 'full context' toggle
Make SLO deltas color-coded but avoid alarmist red — use orange for warnings and include recommended mitigations
tradeoffs: Including live cost delta increases surface complexity and backend calls; tradeoff accepted for higher signal to owners during setup
Exporting full context may expose sensitive links; defaulting to minimal context reduces inadvertent disclosure
Tighter integration with runtime for model fallback info yields better handoffs but couples console and runtime releases
